narrative.details:
adventurer, can ye find him? Can you find Hammertoe in Uldaman?

If those dirty Shadowforge are holdin' him hostage to figure out what he knows about the titan excavations, then all of Ironforge could be in huge trouble.

For a long time now those Dark Irons have been lookin' for magics to make more powerful golems. Hammertoe was doin' the same, of course, but only to stop them.

They're probably keepin' him alive until they learn what he knows.Ye've got to hurry if you're gonna save him!
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes? Ah'm sorry... <cough> Feel so weak. Can ye come closer, Champion?

Ryedol sent ye? Muradin be praised, that boy's not as slow in the head as I once thought. <cough>

chain.subtitle: 9 quests from level 35 to 45, 27,150 XP in all.

quests.name: A Sign of Hope
quests.objectiveText: Find Prospector Ryedol and let him know Hammertoe Grez is alive.

quests.name: Amulet of Secrets
quests.objectiveText: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.

quests.name: Prospect of Faith
quests.objectiveText: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands.

quests.name: Prospect of Faith
quests.objectiveText: Take Hammertoe's Amulet to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

quests.name: Passing Word of a Threat
quests.objectiveText: Find Advisor Belgrum and give him his note.

quests.name: An Ambassador of Evil
quests.objectiveText: Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.

quests.name: The Lost Tablets of Will
quests.objectiveText: Find the Tablet of Will, and return them to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
